description: This Java source file defines an Akka actor class 'RetrieveConnectionLogsAggregatorActor' that handles the aggregation of connection log retrieval responses, manages timeouts, and enforces log size limits before sending the aggregated response back to the requester.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionLogsAggregatorActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that aggregates multiple RetrieveConnectionLogsResponse messages, manages timeouts, and enforces maximum log size limits before replying with a consolidated response.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Static factory method to create Props configuration for creating instances of this actor.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling logic for the actor, configuring responses for RetrieveConnectionLogsResponse, ReceiveTimeout, and any other messages.

methods.name: handleReceiveTimeout
methods.description: Handles timeout events; sends timeout response if no answer received, or final response if partial response is ready.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Lifecycle hook that sets the receive timeout when the actor starts.

methods.name: handleRetrieveConnectionLogsResponse
methods.description: Processes incoming log responses, merging them until all expected responses are received.

methods.name: sendResponse
methods.description: Sends the aggregated and possibly size-restricted response back to the original sender.

methods.name: restrictMaxLogEntriesLength
methods.description: Ensures the total size of log entries does not exceed the maximum allowed size by filtering out older entries.
